**Purpose:** Supplemental Figures 1 and 2.
Extracted and reorganized from `01_data_preparation_qc.Rmd`.

**S1 Fig:** SILAC label incorporation validation — auxotrophic vs prototrophic comparison,
MS scan counts, m/z spectra comparison.

**S2 Fig:** Technical vs biological variation — proteome + phosphoproteome replicate
scatter plots, PCA.

**Inputs:**
- `tables/master_tidy_protein.csv`
- `tables/normed_ratio_perseus.csv`
- `data/proteinGroups.csv` (raw MaxQuant output)

**Run from repo root:** `rmarkdown::render("sfig/SFig_1_2.Rmd")`

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.retina = 2)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(reshape2)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggfortify)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cowplot)
library(GGally)

out_dir  <- "sfig/plots"
data_dir <- "sfig/source_data"
dir.create(out_dir,  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(data_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data}
master        <- read_csv("./tables/master_tidy_protein.csv",
                          show_col_types = FALSE)
normed_ratio  <- read_csv("./tables/normed_ratio_perseus.csv",
                          show_col_types = FALSE)
```

# S1 Fig — SILAC label incorporation validation

## S1A — Label incorporation efficiency (auxotrophic vs prototrophic)

```{r s1a-incorporation}
# Heavy/medium label incorporation efficiency is quantified as the fraction of
# peptide signal in the labeled channels vs total signal for each protein.
# Data comes from the special prototrophic/auxotrophic comparison experiments
# (proteinGroups_pro_auxo_M.csv and proteinGroups_pro_auxo_H.csv in figure1/).
# If those files are not in this repo, adapt the path accordingly.

auxo_path_M <- "./figure1/proteinGroups_pro_auxo_M.csv"
auxo_path_H <- "./figure1/proteinGroups_pro_auxo_H.csv"

if (file.exists(auxo_path_M) && file.exists(auxo_path_H)) {
  wt_M <- read_csv(auxo_path_M, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::select(`Protein IDs`, contains("Intensity")) %>%
    dplyr::select(`Protein IDs`, contains(c("4", "5"))) %>%
    filter(if_any(-`Protein IDs`, ~ . != 0))

  wt_H <- read_csv(auxo_path_H, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::select(`Protein IDs`, contains("Intensity")) %>%
    dplyr::select(`Protein IDs`, contains(c("4", "5"))) %>%
    filter(if_any(-`Protein IDs`, ~ . != 0))

  # Compute fraction labeled per protein
  calc_frac <- function(df, label) {
    # Assumes columns: Intensity [H/M] X, Intensity X (total)
    df %>%
      pivot_longer(-`Protein IDs`) %>%
      mutate(channel = ifelse(grepl(paste0("Intensity ", label, " "), name),
                              "labeled", "total")) %>%
      group_by(`Protein IDs`, channel) %>%
      summarise(val = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = channel, values_from = val) %>%
      mutate(frac_labeled = labeled / total,
             isotope_label = label) %>%
      filter(!is.na(frac_labeled), is.finite(frac_labeled))
  }

  frac_H <- calc_frac(wt_H, "H")
  frac_M <- calc_frac(wt_M, "M")
  frac_df <- bind_rows(frac_H, frac_M)

  p_S1A <- ggplot(frac_df, aes(x = frac_labeled, fill = isotope_label,
                                color = isotope_label)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("H" = "#4b006e", "M" = "#ae00ff"),
                      labels = c("H" = "Heavy (Arg10/Lys8)",
                                 "M" = "Medium (Arg6/Lys4)")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("H" = "#4b006e", "M" = "#ae00ff"),
                       labels = c("H" = "Heavy (Arg10/Lys8)",
                                  "M" = "Medium (Arg6/Lys4)")) +
    xlim(0.9, 1.0) +
    xlab("Fraction of peptide signal from labeled amino acids") +
    ylab("Density") +
    theme_cowplot(font_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank())

  print(p_S1A)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "SFig1A_label_incorporation.pdf"),
         p_S1A, width = 6, height = 4, useDingbats = FALSE)

  write_csv(frac_df %>%
              dplyr::select(`Protein IDs`, isotope_label, frac_labeled),
            file.path(data_dir, "SFig1A_source_data.csv"))
  message("SFig1A: ", nrow(frac_df), " proteins")
} else {
  message("SFig1A: auxotrophic comparison files not found — skipping.\n",
          "  Expected: ", auxo_path_M, " and ", auxo_path_H)
}
```

## S1B — MS scan counts per sample

```{r s1b-scan-counts}
# Scan counts (number of identified proteins / phosphosites) per sample
# Extracted from normed_ratio table as number of non-NA entries per condition
scan_counts <- normed_ratio %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(`Protein IDs`, `Gene names`, `Protein names`,
                  `Fasta headers`),
               names_to = "sample", values_to = "ratio") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ratio)) %>%
  separate(sample, c("genotype", "nutrient", "time", "replicate"),
           sep = "_", extra = "drop") %>%
  group_by(genotype, nutrient, time, replicate) %>%
  summarise(n_proteins = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(genotype), genotype %in% c("WT", "rim15KO"))

p_S1B <- ggplot(scan_counts,
                aes(x = time, y = n_proteins,
                    group = replicate, color = replicate)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(nutrient ~ genotype,
             labeller = labeller(
               genotype = c("WT" = "WT", "rim15KO" = "rim15Δ"),
               nutrient = c("C" = "Carbon", "P" = "Phosphorus"))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("R1" = "#789cff", "R2" = "#656371", "R3" = "#ff7369")) +
  xlab("Timepoint") +
  ylab("Number of proteins quantified") +
  theme_cowplot(font_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"))

p_S1B
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "SFig1B_scan_counts.pdf"),
       p_S1B, width = 8, height = 5, useDingbats = FALSE)

write_csv(scan_counts, file.path(data_dir, "SFig1B_source_data.csv"))
```

# S2 Fig — Technical vs biological variation

## S2A — Replicate scatter plots (proteome)

```{r s2a-replicate-scatter}
# Pairwise scatter of replicate normalized ratios to show technical reproducibility
# Using WT + carbon starvation T16 as a representative condition
rep_scatter <- normed_ratio %>%
  dplyr::select(`Protein IDs`, `Gene names`,
                matches("WT_C_T16_R[123]")) %>%
  drop_na()

if (ncol(rep_scatter) >= 4) {
  names(rep_scatter) <- c("Protein IDs", "Gene names", "Rep1", "Rep2", "Rep3")

  p_S2A_12 <- ggscatter(rep_scatter, x = "Rep1", y = "Rep2",
                         alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8) +
    stat_cor(method = "pearson") +
    scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
    xlab("Replicate 1") + ylab("Replicate 2") +
    ggtitle("WT, C starvation, T=16 h") +
    theme_cowplot(font_size = 11)

  p_S2A_13 <- ggscatter(rep_scatter, x = "Rep1", y = "Rep3",
                         alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8) +
    stat_cor(method = "pearson") +
    scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
    xlab("Replicate 1") + ylab("Replicate 3") +
    ggtitle("WT, C starvation, T=16 h") +
    theme_cowplot(font_size = 11)

  p_S2A <- plot_grid(p_S2A_12, p_S2A_13, ncol = 2)
  print(p_S2A)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "SFig2A_replicate_scatter.pdf"),
         p_S2A, width = 10, height = 5, useDingbats = FALSE)

  write_csv(rep_scatter, file.path(data_dir, "SFig2A_source_data.csv"))
}
```

## S2B — PCA of proteome samples

```{r s2b-pca}
# PCA on normalized ratio matrix (wide: columns = samples, rows = proteins)
nr_wide <- normed_ratio %>%
  dplyr::select(`Protein IDs`, matches("(WT|rim15KO)_(C|P)_T[0-9]+_R[123]$")) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Protein IDs")

# Remove columns (samples) or rows (proteins) with excessive NAs
nr_wide <- nr_wide[, colSums(is.na(nr_wide)) < nrow(nr_wide) * 0.5]
nr_wide <- nr_wide[rowSums(is.na(nr_wide)) < ncol(nr_wide) * 0.5, ]
# Replace remaining NAs with column means
for (j in seq_along(nr_wide)) {
  nr_wide[is.na(nr_wide[, j]), j] <- mean(nr_wide[, j], na.rm = TRUE)
}

pca_res <- prcomp(t(nr_wide), scale. = TRUE)
pca_df  <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x[, 1:3]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  separate(sample, c("genotype", "nutrient", "time", "replicate"),
           sep = "_", remove = FALSE)

pct_var <- round(100 * pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2), 1)

p_S2B <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2,
                              color = genotype, shape = nutrient)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("WT" = "#E7B800", "rim15KO" = "#00AFBB"),
                     labels = c("WT" = "WT", "rim15KO" = "rim15Δ")) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", pct_var[1], "%)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", pct_var[2], "%)")) +
  theme_cowplot(font_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p_S2B
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "SFig2B_proteome_PCA.pdf"),
       p_S2B, width = 7, height = 5, useDingbats = FALSE)

write_csv(pca_df, file.path(data_dir, "SFig2B_source_data.csv"))
message("SFig2B PCA saved")
```
